annotations.title: Capture a page's own API calls (XHR/fetch)

description: Load a web page in a real browser through ScrapeUnblocker and return the JSON its own API calls received: every XHR/fetch response whose URL contains `capture_xhr` (a fragment such as '/api/search'), in order, with status and body. Use it when a site renders from a JSON API that refuses direct requests (the page signs each call): the page makes the call, so it succeeds, and the JSON is cleaner than the HTML. Optional `steps` make the page fire the call (a search, 'load more'); steps act on the website and run once. Up to 20 responses; the page HTML is not returned. Billed as one request; when the site refuses every matching call (403/429) the call fails and is free.

capture_xhr.description: A fragment of the API URL the page calls, e.g. '/api/search'. Every XHR/fetch response whose URL contains it is returned (plain substring, case-sensitive).

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to route through, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE'.

steps.description: Optional browser actions that make the page fire the call, run after the page loads. Use `list_elements` first to find selectors. Runs once.

oneOf.description: Wait until an element matching `selector` exists.
Wait until the given text appears on the page.

value.description: Text to wait for anywhere on the page.

oneOf.description: Pause for a fixed number of milliseconds.

selector.description: Selector of the element to click.

oneOf.description: Type text into an input, character by character.

selector.description: Selector of the field to type into.

oneOf.description: Choose an option in a <select> dropdown by value.
Scroll the page to the bottom or by a pixel amount.

value.description: 'bottom' to scroll to the end, or a pixel offset.
